scope: Source verification and isolated Windows desktop acceptance before packaging and publication

manual.englishImages: The English manual explicitly reuses the native German UI screenshots.

nativeAcceptance.manualAssertions: Both complete fresh runs passed without partial/resume flags or interaction retries; all owned Desktop processes exited with code 0.
manualCoverage: Fixed six-entry PGN import and bulk deletion limited to the two disposable sketches
Actual Stockfish and Maia 1500/1800 configuration, restart, completed analysis and diagnostic report export
Immutable game, path-to-note, independent derived analysis, main-line extension/truncation/replacement, variations and direct board takeback
Actual Stockfish playout, pause/restart/resume, saved game and discarded second playout
Root-only opening library, independent source relationships and freely constructed starting position
Three working contexts with isolated notes and different drafts, context switches and restarts
Context inclusion/removal, folder-only versus content snapshots, later additions and global folder/item moves
Stale metadata and impact decisions rejected without partial writes
Use new version, preserve old version as an independent analysis with notes/draft, or remove only the local usage
Second revision, unaffected context copy, context deletion cancel/confirm and final restart
German and English Settings, Manage, Analysis and offline Live smoke
observations: Expected rapid-focus interruptions and context-membership rejections were logged; passing workflow assertions do not imply that every HTTP request succeeded.

The second manual run logged one background AnalyzePosition provider timeout after its final restart. Provider, focus and whether a transient UI error appeared are not established by the sanitized log. Later native analysis captures show Stockfish results again; no causal product-fix claim is made.

An earlier complete source run had three Stockfish fixture warmup timeouts. An unchanged read-phase probe subsequently passed all twelve tests. Timeout/chatter assertions were strengthened to require an actual search command; no deadlines were extended.

dependencyAudit.fullAudit: One moderate advisory remains in an optional build-only sprintf-js dependency; no available published fixed version and no custom vendor patch.

boundaries: Native acceptance uses isolated application homes and real Host/Desktop processes; no user profiles, credentials or real online account actions.
Live uses deterministic official-API-shaped test responses, not a real remote game or an Internet timing guarantee.
Automated keyboard/pointer, axe and native screenshots do not substitute for physical touch, Narrator/NVDA or a full manual 400-percent zoom acceptance.
Only Windows x64 is supported; no actual Linux or macOS acceptance.
Signing, full Stable fuse hardening, migration, integrated backup/restore and complete upgrade rollback are not claimed.
The manual is versioned with the release source and linked from release notes; no separate offline manual bundle is claimed.
Installer, downloaded-asset and publication checks are subsequent independent gates, not implied by this source/native report.
